message: Gradient detected. Verify semantic/product purpose rather than generic decoration.
Backdrop blur detected. Inspect contrast and whether translucency communicates a real layer.
Common AI/sparkle motif detected. Prefer a descriptive affordance when decorative.
Focus suppression detected. Verify an equally visible focus-visible style.
Clickable div detected. Prefer semantic button/link or complete keyboard semantics.
Clickable span detected. Prefer semantic button/link or complete keyboard semantics.
Placeholder detected. Verify a persistent visible/programmatic label also exists.
Large/full radius detected. Inspect whether repeated AI-default styling.
Colored shadow/glow detected. Verify it does not compete with information.
Hover scale detected. Verify it helps affordance and does not destabilize dense UI.
Very small text detected. Inspect readability, zoom and suppressed metadata.
Pulse/blink detected. Verify it is not used as the sole urgency cue or decorative AI motion.
Pie/donut visualization detected. Verify part-to-whole comparison truly benefits from it.
Gauge/radial visualization detected. Verify it is more informative than a value/range.
Score language detected. Verify score provenance/validation and that UI does not invent clinical meaning.
Generic AI marketing copy detected inside product UI. Prefer task-specific capability language.
Title tooltip on interactive control detected. Verify visible/accessible naming and no essential hover-only content.
Text truncation detected. Verify patient identity, units, warnings and critical values remain fully accessible.
Emoji detected in UI source. Verify it is not being used as a clinical/AI semantic substitute.
Pill styling detected. Inspect whether semantic states are being over-compressed into pills.
